Daily loads, no duplicates

A load you can run twice.

WHERE NOT EXISTSMERGE INTOIdempotent
The problem

Jobs run twice

Plain insert
Twice = doubled
A retry or a second click loads the same day again.
Idempotent load
Twice = the same
Insert only the rows whose key is new.
Project 2 · Lesson 3.2
MERGE INTO

Update what matches, insert the rest

upsert (DuckDB SQL)
MERGE INTO raw.blocks AS t USING (SELECT … FROM read_parquet('…/date=2026-11-02/*.parquet')) AS s ON (t.number = s.number) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT;
Studio's SQL Editor does not accept MERGE. dbt runs a real MERGE on this lake in Lesson 6.3.

Recap

What to remember

1
Insert only rows whose key is new.
2
Run twice: the table does not change.
3
An empty change makes no snapshot.
4
MERGE INTO upserts: update and insert.
